decisionReason: Authored profile and both independent template groups allow incompatible mass and volume units; default Litre is also supplied by a generic compiler family. No exact liquid-only/powder-only material evidence or concrete distinct material products exist in repository evidence/local references. Mixed allowed units do not prove DISTINCT_PRODUCTS_REQUIRED.

rejectedConclusions.VOLUME: Litre is a default, not an exclusive material declaration; authored profile includes Kilogram/Gram.
rejectedConclusions.MASS: No powder/cementitious-only declaration; authored profile includes Litre/Millilitre.
rejectedConclusions.DISTINCT_PRODUCTS_REQUIRED: Mixed allowed-unit metadata is not evidence of actual separate incompatible products; no Product references provide such evidence.

requiredDomainDecision.physicalForm: Explicitly liquid-only, powder/cementitious-only, or intentionally separate forms with approved content definitions.
requiredDomainDecision.measurementDimension: One exact VOLUME or MASS dimension per canonical form.
requiredDomainDecision.sellingPresentation: Compatible explicit selling units/default; containers do not establish measurement base.

compilerEvidence.historicalBranch: categoryId / category-name / subcategory-name waterproofing or damp matching; not an authored exclusive Basement material contract.
